Magister, I know you mean well, but since you've discovered my true identity, could you stop feeding me like an ordinary animal?

Since these berries are washed fairly clean, I'll accept them just this once.

Actually, delicacies like foie gras from the upper district restaurants, or braised meat from the royal kitchen, are more up my alley...

With your wisdom, I'm sure you can catch my drift, right?
document:604.source_cn:
某位好心的大魔法师，既然你已经知道本狐的身份了，就别把本狐当宠物投喂了！
看在这些浆果清洗得还算干净的份上，这次本狐就勉强收下。
下次，比起这些随处可见的浆果，本狐更希望能在食盆里看见上城区餐厅的特供鹅肝，或者王宫御膳房刚出锅的红酒炖肉……
我想，以大魔法师的智慧，应该能明白本狐的意思吧？
